divergences.old: github commands putting owner, repo, label and ref into request paths as typed, so a "." or ".." segment (or its %2e or backslash form) was collapsed by URL parsing and the request, a DELETE included, went to a different resource on the same host
divergences.toil: A path with a "." or ".." segment is refused with INVALID_INPUT before anything is sent. Every other character still goes in unencoded, as before (#72 item 4)
divergences.why: A write approved for one resource must not land on another: --label ../../../repos/o/r on remove-label would otherwise send DELETE /repos/o/r.

divergences.old: github delete-comment, delete-review-comment, remove-label, remove-reviewers and remove-assignees available to every caller
divergences.toil: The same commands on the CLI; toil mcp never serves them
divergences.why: Deletes are never exposed through MCP (CLAUDE.md, Writes).

divergences.old: github list-prs, list-comments, list-review-comments, list-files, list-reviews and list-checks paging until a short page, with no limit on the number of pages
divergences.toil: The same short-page stop, plus a bound: after 1,000 pages (100,000 items) the command fails with HTTP, naming what was being paged, and fix text to narrow the request
divergences.why: A server that ignores the page parameter would otherwise be asked for the same page forever; the bound turns a hang into an error that says what happened.

divergences.old: github list-review-threads printing "warning: more than N review threads ..." to stderr when the first 100 threads aren't all of them
divergences.toil: The same text as a GITHUB_REVIEW_THREADS_TRUNCATED entry in meta.warnings; data is unchanged
divergences.why: An MCP client never sees stderr, so a truncation it can't see would fail silently. meta.warnings is the envelope's place for it (Output Contract).

divergences.old: GraphQL failures (review threads, pr-status, auto-merge, merge queue, drafts, resolve-thread) reported as the joined error messages alone, or "GraphQL response contained no data"
divergences.toil: "GitHub GraphQL error: <messages joined with '; '>", or "GitHub answered the GraphQL query at <url> with no data.", both as HTTP with a fix, from core's one GraphQL helper
divergences.why: Every area's GraphQL calls fail the same way, saying which service failed and what to check next.

divergences.old: github diff failing at once on a 429 with the server's message (its text request skipped the retry every other call had; #72 item 11)
divergences.toil: diff retries a 429 like every other GitHub call, honouring Retry-After up to 30 s, then fails with "Rate limited" and retryAfterSeconds in details
divergences.why: Core's one request path retries every 429 and offers no opt-out, so the suspected bug can't be kept without a core change; the retry is what the other GitHub calls already did.

divergences.old: github add-labels typed its data as { labels: [...] }
divergences.toil: data is GitHub's answer passed through unchanged, as before. GitHub answers with a bare array of labels, so the contract's typed field never existed at run time
divergences.why: Nothing changes; the recorded field came from the old code's type, not from what GitHub returns, and a fixture shaped like the real API can't carry it.

divergences.old: github add-reviewers typed its data as { url, users, teams }
divergences.toil: data is GitHub's answer passed through unchanged, as before. GitHub answers a reviewer request with the pull request, which has url and requested_reviewers but no users or teams
divergences.why: Nothing changes; the recorded fields came from the old code's type, not from what GitHub returns, and a fixture shaped like the real API can't carry them.
